name: citation-verifier
description: Audit whether cited papers support manuscript claims, with verified quotations and review exports.

interface.shortDescription: Check citation support with evidence you can inspect
defaultPrompt: Check whether the citations in this manuscript support its claims. Present a preflight work summary and inspect supported explicit model selection before dispatch; prefer an appropriate supported lower-cost model, and do not assume inherited model cost. Use two fresh native reviewer subagents per batch, with neither reviewer seeing the other verdict. Continue all approved batches and preserve evidence and human verdicts.
